Trivial sample to prove the render; not a real lesson. Shape aligned to les-01's decidedValueShape (design-kb/design-kb.gates.json).

lesson.title: Finding the claim
lesson.topic: Telling a claim from a reason
lesson.conceptTitle: A claim is the one thing an argument asks you to accept
lesson.description: You meet short arguments and learn to point to the one sentence the writer most wants you to accept.

outcomes.text: Identify the main claim in a short argument.
Tell a claim apart from a reason that supports it.
Mark the claim in an argument from your own subject.

teaching.workedExample: A short paragraph argues that a town should keep its library open. You work through it line by line and mark the one sentence everything else is there to support.

visualAssets.placeholder: simple diagram: claim at the top, reasons feeding into it

reflectivePrompt: Think of something you argued recently. What was the one thing you were really trying to get the other person to accept?

contextQuestionSlot.specification: A multiple-choice item whose argument is drawn from the learner's own subject by the context pack.
